summary: Frontend-only retest of the 'AI Profile Settings' Alpine.js dynamic-array bug (Tambah Skill / Sertifikasi / Bahasa) on http://localhost:8000/settings?tab=ai-profile using Playwright. RESULT: THE REPORTED BUG IS NOT FIXED. The three 'Tambah' buttons still do nothing (0 rows added after 1 and 2 clicks). Conclusively root-caused: Alpine.js is NEVER LOADED on the /settings page (window.Alpine === undefined), so x-data / x-for / @click are inert. The developer's fix (inline x-data object literal) is not the problem area - proven by injecting Alpine 3.15.12 via CDN at runtime on the same page, after which all 3 add buttons and all 3 remove buttons worked perfectly (0->1->2 rows, correct name attributes skills[0][name], skills[0][level]=INTERMEDIATE). Backend save + DB persistence + completeness badge all work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: USER BUG STILL REPRODUCES. Clicking 'Tambah Skill' / 'Tambah Sertifikasi' / 'Tambah Bahasa' adds 0 rows. Root cause: Alpine.js is not loaded on /settings?tab=ai-profile. Verified: window.Alpine === undefined, root element has no _x_dataStack, and the x-if empty-state placeholders ('Belum ada skill.', 'Belum ada sertifikasi.', 'Belum ada bahasa.') never render either - proof that NO Alpine directive is being processed. The rendered HTML of that page contains zero references to livewire.js (only /build/assets/app-*.js and bootstrap-*.js). Alpine is only present on pages that render a Livewire component (e.g. /apply loads livewire.js which bundles Alpine 3.15.8); the ai-profile tab is plain Blade, so it gets no Alpine at all.

Uncaught ReferenceError 'Alpine is not defined' thrown on EVERY page (login, dashboard, settings, apply). Last two lines of resources/js/app.js call `Alpine.data('glintsSearchLocation', glintsSearchLocation)` but `alpinejs` is never imported and no global window.Alpine exists at that point (grep of the built bundle public/build/assets/app-Ie1RVFbG.js shows the only Alpine token is `Alpine.data`, alpinejs is NOT bundled). This top-level throw aborts the app.js module, which also means `window.lucide` is never exposed globally and the glintsSearchLocation Alpine component is never registered anywhere.

The trash/delete buttons on dynamically added rows render as empty rose-colored rectangles with no icon. addSkill()/addSertifikasi()/addBahasa() call `if (window.lucide) window.lucide.createIcons()`, but window.lucide is never set (see app.js bug above), so the `<i data-lucide="trash-2">` placeholders stay blank. Confirmed visually after injecting Alpine manually.

issues: 'Profil kandidat' pill badge in the card header wraps onto two lines ('Profil' / 'kandidat') at 1920px - add whitespace-nowrap.
Dynamic row delete buttons appear as blank rose rectangles (missing lucide icon) - no affordance for the user.
Skills/Sertifikasi/Bahasa sections render as almost-empty ~60px bands with no empty-state text (because Alpine x-if is dead), making the page look broken.

action_items: CRITICAL: Make Alpine available on non-Livewire Blade pages. The ai-profile tab is plain Blade so it receives no Alpine. Options: (a) add `@livewireScripts` to resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php so Livewire's bundled Alpine loads on every authenticated page, or (b) bundle Alpine yourself in resources/js/app.js (`import Alpine from 'alpinejs'; window.Alpine = Alpine; Alpine.start()`) - but if you do (b) you MUST prevent the duplicate-Alpine clash with Livewire 4's own Alpine instance on pages like /apply.

CRITICAL: Fix `Alpine is not defined` ReferenceError in resources/js/app.js - move `Alpine.data('glintsSearchLocation', ...)` inside `document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => { ... })` and rebuild vite assets. Right now this exception aborts app.js on every page.
Expose lucide globally (`window.lucide = { createIcons, icons }`) in resources/js/app.js so dynamically added rows get their trash-2 icon rendered.
Add whitespace-nowrap to the 'Profil kandidat' header pill.
Update seeding docs/seeder so the test user has email_verified_at set (login currently bounces to /verify-email).
After the Alpine fix, re-run `npm run build` (vite) - the current public/build bundle is stale relative to any app.js change and does not contain alpinejs.
critical_code_review_comments: tests/Feature/Settings/AiProfileTest.php passes 7 tests but they are server-side Blade/HTTP assertions only - they can never catch this bug because the failure is that Alpine JS is absent in the browser. These are not a valid regression test for the reported user bug; a browser-level (Dusk/Playwright) test asserting row count after clicking the add button is required.
The claimed fix (switching from `aiProfileForm({...})` to an inline object literal) addressed a symptom hypothesis, not the actual cause. Both forms are equally dead when Alpine never loads.

resources/js/app.js references a global `Alpine` that the bundle never defines - this is an unguarded top-level throw that silently kills all other module side effects (lucide icon bootstrap, sidebar init ordering).
Alpine availability is implicitly coupled to 'does this page happen to render a Livewire component' - fragile. Any future plain-Blade page with x-data will silently break the same way.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Laravel 11 + Livewire 4 + Alpine (via Livewire bundle) + Vite, served at http://localhost:8000 by `php artisan serve`. DB is SQLite /app/database/testing.sqlite (no sqlite3 CLI in container - use `php artisan tinker --execute=...`). Login flow: POST /login with input[name=email]/input[name=password] + button[type=submit] -> /dashboard. Verify BEFORE testing Alpine behaviour: `await page.evaluate('() => !!window.Alpine')` on /settings?tab=ai-profile - if false, the add-row bug is still present and everything else in that tab is moot. To confirm the Blade markup itself is fine you can `await page.add_script_tag(url='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.15.12/dist/cdn.min.js')` and the buttons then work. Also expect the harmless-looking but fatal pageerror 'Alpine is not defined' from app.js and pusher WebSocket ws://localhost:8080 connection-refused console errors (Reverb not running - unrelated to this feature).
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE (proven, not inferred): Alpine.js is never loaded on /settings?tab=ai-profile. 1) The rendered HTML of that route contains only /build/assets/app-*.js and bootstrap-*.js - zero livewire.js. Livewire 4 auto-injects its script (which bundles Alpine 3.15.8) only on pages rendering a Livewire component; layouts/app.blade.php has no @livewireScripts, and the ai-profile tab is pure Blade. 2) The vite bundle does not contain alpinejs at all - grep of public/build/assets/app-Ie1RVFbG.js finds only the token `Alpine.data`, i.e. resources/js/app.js calls `Alpine.data('glintsSearchLocation', ...)` against a global that does not exist, throwing 'Alpine is not defined' on every page load. 3) Consequence: x-data, x-for, x-if and @click on the ai-profile form are never initialised - window.Alpine is undefined, the root node has no _x_dataStack, and even the static x-if empty-state texts do not render. REPRODUCTION: login -> GET /settings?tab=ai-profile -> click [data-testid='ai-profile-add-skill'] twice -> [data-testid='ai-profile-skill-row'] count stays 0 (same for sertifikasi and bahasa). PROOF OF FIX DIRECTION: injecting Alpine 3.15.12 from CDN at runtime on the unmodified page makes all three add buttons produce 0->1->2 rows with correct name bindings (skills[0][name], skills[0][level]='INTERMEDIATE') and the remove buttons decrement correctly. MITIGATION: load Alpine on this page (add @livewireScripts to the app layout, or import+start Alpine in resources/js/app.js while avoiding a duplicate-instance clash with Livewire), move the Alpine.data registration into the 'alpine:init' listener, then rebuild vite assets.
